column2: Introduction to life Drawing Readiness test
column3: By the end of the lesson, pupils should be able to: i. appraise life drawing; ii. identify different parts of the body; iii. sketch a full human figure.
By the end of the lesson, pupils should be able to: i. tap the bass drum rhythm of the Nigerian National Anthem; ii. explain rhythm; iii. analyse types of rhythm;

By the end of the lesson, pupils should be able to: i. identify elements of a play production; ii. mention the various people involved in a play production; iii. evaluate one Nigerian theatrical personnel in history.
By the end of the lesson, pupils should be able to: i. state the forms of dance; ii. criticize notable Nigerian dancers; iii. demonstrate one form of dance.
By the end of the lesson, pupils should be able to: i. analyse imaginative drawing; ii. draw from imagination; iii. evaluate created artwork.
By the end of the lesson, pupils should be able to: i. explain choral singing; ii. classify choral singing, iii. list types of singing
By the end of the lesson, pupils should be able to; i. analyse the process of casting; ii. discuss the meaning of rehearsal; iii. plan a rehearsal schedule for end of term/year play .
By the end of the lesson, pupils should be able to: i. list the types of cards; ii. justify materials for making cards; iii. create greeting cards
